testcase.name: Scenario: Select a ribbon tab from the overflow menu: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-display-source/features/application/ribbon-display/ribbon-display.feature:374:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Select a ribbon tab from the overflow menu ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Manage ribbon visible ✔ And the application window is narrow enough that View is outside the visible tab row ✔ When the user clicks the ribbon tab overflow control ✔ Then a menu lists the tabs that do not fit in the row, including View ✔ When the user selects View from the overflow menu ✔ Then the menu closes and the View command groups replace the Manage command groups ✔ And View remains outside the visible tab row at this window width ✔ When the user maximizes the application window ✔ Then View is visible and active in the tab row ✔ And its command groups and the part remain visible
